title: Terraform state and locking concepts
summary: Separate state, backend, workspace, operation locking and provider dependency locking.

concepts.title: State
concepts.explanation: Maps configuration objects to remote objects and stores operational metadata.

concepts.title: Backend
concepts.explanation: Determines where state is stored and which locking behavior is supported.

concepts.title: Operation lock
concepts.explanation: Protects state from concurrent supported operations.

concepts.title: Dependency lock file
concepts.explanation: .terraform.lock.hcl records provider selections; it is not the runtime state lock.

limitations: Lock age alone does not prove an operation is stale.
Unlock behavior is backend-specific, and some backends do not support force-unlock.
